name: The Ensorcelled Parchment
label: Quest
description: A spell on a parchment makes its writing unreadable, apart from one word at the top: Nagaz. You are to take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
intro: A spell on a parchment makes its writing unreadable, apart from one word at the top: Nagaz. You are to take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This parchment is enchanted with a spell, rendering it indecipherable. But one word at the top of the paper can be read:

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh. You have something you'd like me to look at? Some scrap of lore gathered from up in the mountains, I hope...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wish I had the talents to decrypt all the strange bits of writing that trickle down from Alterac. But I'm afraid I lack the knowledge.
